title: Guide book shell and Items tab (search, obtained from, crafted from, used in, stations)
player_outcome: Press G (or the book button in the inventory) to open a Terraria-styled Guide book. The Items tab searches every item and shows where it drops (with %), who sells it, what it is crafted from and at which station, and what it is used in. Clicking an ingredient jumps to it.
design: Input: add 'guide_book': ['key:G'] to data/config/input.json. Check for conflicts with other phases' new keys (H/J/B are Terraria quick heal/mana/buff, so G avoids them).

New game/UI/GuideBook/GuideBookScreen.cs (CanvasLayer, Layer 24, InputGate 'guide'). It is built lazily on first open: a dim backdrop and a centred two-page book panel (UiTheme blue panels, header font, page-turn SFX), with bookmark tabs across the top (Items, Bestiary, Bosses, NPCs, Tips, Achievements). Each tab is an IGuideTab control built on first selection. Esc or G closes it. The inventory gets a book button through InventoryScreen.Tabs.cs.

Build a Core GuideIndex (Gameplay/Guide/GuideIndex.cs: ItemSources (P5-24), RecipeLookup (P5-14), name/tag search keys) on a background Task at world launch (content is immutable, so this is thread-safe). The book shows 'Loading…' until it completes.

ItemsTab (game/UI/GuideBook/ItemsTab.cs): a LineEdit search (sets InputGate.TextEntry while focused), a category OptionButton, and an ItemList virtual list of ~700 items (text immediately; icons lazily loaded for the visible range, 16 per frame via ItemIcons). The right page (ItemDetails.cs) shows a big icon and rarity-coloured name, the ItemTooltip lines, 'Obtained from' (source rows: enemy name + drop % from DropRates + conditions text; shops with seller and conditions; chests; crafting), 'Crafted from' (RecipeCards), 'Used in' (paged RecipeCards, 8 per page), and 'Crafting station for N recipes' when the item places a station. Rows link to items, and a back button keeps history.
Engine commands 'ui book [tab]' and 'ui book_item <id>'; probes ui.book_open and ui.book_sources (the source count for the shown item).
Perf: nothing built until first open; RecipeCards pooled; no per-frame rebuilds (the CraftingPanel audit issue); detail rebuilt only on selection.
files_modify: game/Bootstrap/InputSetup.cs (if actions need registration) — none expected
game/Debug/EngineCommands.Town.cs (or a new EngineCommands.Guide.cs) — ui book
tests: GuideIndexTests: searching 'pick' returns copper_pickaxe; Build completes under 200 ms in the test (measure)
Smoke guide.cmds: 'ui book items' / 'assert ui.book_open == 1' / 'ui book_item torch' / 'assert ui.book_sources >= 2' / 'ui close'
verification: In game: G opens the book with no hitch (F3 frame graph); search 'bar'; click Iron Bar → Used in lists anvils and tools with named stations; the Gel sources show slimes with %
risks: The UI phase introduces the font and theme; the book must use UiTheme so it picks those up automatically.
The G key may collide with another phase's binding; settle it in the phase sync.
